fields.caption: Leopard in the Canopy, Sabi Sands
fields.alt: A leopard's face peers directly at the camera from within tree branches in the Sabi Sands reserve, surrounded by lush greenery.
fields.story: A leopard peers curiously from its perch in a tree, its piercing gaze fixed on the camera. The scene captures the wild beauty and alertness of this majestic predator in its natural habitat near Kruger.

fields.caption: The Golden Temple at Night
fields.alt: Nighttime view of the Golden Temple, its golden dome and surrounding structures brilliantly lit and mirrored in the still waters of the reflecting pool below.
fields.story: The Golden Temple, Sikhism's holiest site, glows against the dark sky, its gilded facade and intricate domes mirrored perfectly in the calm sarovar below. Floodlit minarets and the clock tower frame the scene, the stillness of the water doubling every light into a seamless reflection.

fields.caption: Hummingbird at rest, Santiago
fields.alt: A hummingbird with brownish iridescent plumage perches on a thin, leafless branch against a blurred green forest backdrop, its long beak clearly visible.
fields.story: A hummingbird pauses on a bare branch in the forests near Santiago, its iridescent feathers catching the diffuse light of the Chilean hillside.
